sources.label: Wikipedia, "WASP-15b"
sources.quote: WASP-15b, formally named Asye, is an extrasolar planet discovered in 2008 by the SuperWASP collaboration, which seeks to discover exoplanets that transit their host stars.

introduction.text: It is the only planet known around Nyamien. Its orbit and size follow Stassun et al. 2017's fit, the archive's default.
